text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho is a competition
for the
venerable Spring Shield. Biwa
Hayahide looks on
from the stands,
listening to positive pre-race
takes on
Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан squares off against Mejiro
McQueen
and Михоно Бурбон. But no
matter who she's up
against, she only
seeks to prove her own strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Sparks fly between Нарита Брайан and the
other two
racers. Being the one who
challenged everyone,
she can't afford to
lose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
